acceptance_note: Require all exact gates, positive frozen-suite intervals, long-control supplementary and order corroboration, and no unexplained >3% elapsed median regression. No minimum 3% gain cutoff. No acceptance from microbenchmarks alone.
method: exp(mean(per-position median(log(paired wall NPS ratio)))); hierarchical 10,000-draw bootstrap, positions as groups then paired repetitions within position, seed 20261017. Frozen 12 and supplementary 4 analyzed separately. No temporal autocorrelation model or multiplicity adjustment; these are fixture-suite throughput intervals, not Elo.
